I represent the boy's family. He is ready for a professional contract, and we expect an offer from you.
Good day, coach. The boy's contract will not run forever, and we would like to talk about an extension on better terms now.
The family is unsettled because nothing has happened so far. Please give us a clear sign today.
Either the boy gets a professional contract, or I will ask around at other clubs. That is not a threat, that is a promise!
The family feels attached to the club and wants to stay. We only ask for a fair offer.
With his potential he belongs in the first team. We are talking about salary, length and a clear prospect.
I understand the family's concern. The boy matters to us, and I want him to feel secure here.
The numbers are clear: his potential is high, but his performance still has to carry. I am happy to explain how we measure him.
I will make an offer with a salary that grows as he plays. That protects both sides.
Please discuss that with the sporting director, who handles the contract details. I will back him up.
What exactly does the family expect? Give me salary, length and role, then I will see where we stand.
Let us talk about it calmly after the season. Until then the boy should concentrate on his football.
Not on those terms. A professional contract is not a reward for potential but for performance.
My offer stands. If you ask around elsewhere, that is your right, but it changes nothing.
{b.gut} That is a fair tone. I will take it to the family, and I think they will be satisfied.
{b.gut} That is how I always imagined working with this club: reliable and open.
{b.gut} That sounds like a plan with a future. The boy will repay you on the pitch.
{b.neutral} Understood, I will pass it on. You will get the family's answer in the next few days.
{b.neutral} The family will need to digest that first. I will get back to you when they have talked it over.
{b.neutral} You leave much open, but I do not want to push. We will keep talking.
{b.schlecht} You will not convince the family with that. They feel they are being strung along.
{b.schlecht} I take that personally! With that attitude you are throwing away the family's trust!
{b.schlecht} Then I will look for alternatives. Other clubs talk to us with more respect.
{entscheidung} The agent leaves the negotiating table with a smile, and the academy learns that the club stands by its talents.
{entscheidung} Neither side has said everything yet. The family is conferring, and the question stays on the table.
{entscheidung} The agent packs his papers without a word. By the evening it is said that other clubs have called.
{entscheidung} The talks are over. The agent lets it be known that the family is reorienting.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.e.e1: A third-division club would borrow the boy for half a year. With us he hardly plays, there he would be a regular.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.e.e2: I am putting a loan offer in front of you. Match practice against adults matters more for him now than any session with us.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.e.e3: He is flagging because he is not playing, and I see it every day. A loan could save him.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.e.e4: If we let him rot here, that is a disgrace! Release him so he can finally play!
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.e.e5: It is hard for me to let him go, but it is the best for him. I trust your judgment.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.e.e6: He wants to prove himself. On a loan to the third division he would come back in half a year with much more experience.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.a.a1: I will talk to him and his family. They should understand that we are not shunting him off but developing him.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.a.a2: We will loan him out with a recall option and a playing guarantee. Without that promise I will not sign.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.a.a3: I will cover part of his salary so that the club really plays him. That is worth it to me.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.a.a4: Please let the sports department sort out the details. I trust you that the club suits him.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.a.a5: How much has he played in recent weeks, and where exactly is the problem? I want to see the facts first.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.a.a6: Perhaps we wait another month. If he still does not play then, we will talk about the loan again.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.a.a7: No. He stays here, where we know him and he can keep developing. With a stranger he will get lost.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.a.a8: The loan is rejected, and I do not want to discuss it again. He will get his chance with us.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.r.r1: {b.gut} Good, then we will do it properly. The boy will take it as a sign of trust.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.r.r2: {b.gut} That is a clever path. I am sure he will benefit from it.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.r.r3: {b.gut} With this approach he gets the chance to show himself. I am happy for him.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.r.r4: {b.neutral} Okay, I will tell him that. We will see how he takes it.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.r.r5: {b.neutral} That is neither fish nor fowl, but I will pass it on. The boy will ask questions.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.r.r6: {b.neutral} I will wait to see how you decide. Please let me know in good time.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That does not help him. He will lose the desire if he keeps only watching.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.r.r8: {b.schlecht} That is unfair to the boy! You are holding him back although he wants to play!
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.r.r9: {b.schlecht} Then he will find his own way. A boy like that does not wait for long.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.x.x1: {entscheidung} The youth coach breathes a sigh of relief. The boy packs his bags and looks forward to his first games.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.x.x2: {entscheidung} It remains up in the air. The boy keeps training, and the youth coach keeps an eye on him.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.x.x3: {entscheidung} It is said in the academy that the boy feels passed over. The mood among the talents suffers.
pool.jugend_leihe_angebot.x.x4: {entscheidung} The youth coach closes the folder. The loan offer is turned down with the other club.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.e.e1: Our son is supposed to move up to the first team, but we are worried. His school and his home are far away.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.e.e2: We are happy for him, but he is only a teenager. Who looks after him when he moves into a flat alone?
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.e.e3: He sleeps badly and has already missed school twice. We do not know how long this will go on.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.e.e4: If the club puts his diploma at risk, we will take him back! We will not put up with that!
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.e.e5: We trust the club and the academy, but we would like to know how his education will continue.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.e.e6: He is ambitious and wants to move up at all costs. We want to support him without overloading him.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.a.a1: I understand your concern. He will have a contact person with us who takes care of everyday life and school.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.a.a2: We have a concept for young players: supervision, host family or dormitory and time for classes. I am happy to show it to you.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.a.a3: I will have training and classes coordinated and see to it myself that nothing is cancelled.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.a.a4: The youth department will contact you in the next few days and go through everything with you.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.a.a5: What exactly worries you most: the school, the flat or everyday life? I want to address that specifically.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.a.a6: Let us first wait and see how he settles in over the first weeks. Then we will see.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.a.a7: Football comes first. Anyone who wants to make it to the top has to make sacrifices, school included.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.a.a8: The club sets the conditions. If you do not like that, you will have to decide.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.r.r1: {b.gut} That reassures us a lot. Thank you for taking the time.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.r.r2: {b.gut} We had hoped the club would think that way. We will stand by you.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.r.r3: {b.gut} If it goes like that, we will support our son's path wholeheartedly.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.r.r4: {b.neutral} We will take that home and talk to our son.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.r.r5: {b.neutral} We are still unsure, but the conversation was helpful. We will be in touch.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.r.r6: {b.neutral} That sounds reasonable. We will wait and see how it develops.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That does not reassure us. We still lack a binding plan.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.r.r8: {b.schlecht} That is no way to talk to parents! Our son is not material!
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.r.r9: {b.schlecht} Then we will look for a club that sees our son as a person, not just a talent.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.x.x1: {entscheidung} The parents say goodbye relieved, and the boy can look forward to his new challenge.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.x.x2: {entscheidung} The parents want to think it over. The boy waits tensely for their answer.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.x.x3: {entscheidung} The parents leave annoyed. It is said in the academy that the club does not look after its youth.
pool.jugend_eltern_umzug_schule.x.x4: {entscheidung} The conversation ends without a result. The family does not get in touch for now.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.e.e1: The academy season is over. I have written down who is ready, who still needs time and whom we will probably lose.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.e.e2: Here is my review. Some talents have developed better than expected, with others I have become more sceptical.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.e.e3: The review is mixed. We should soon clarify whom we are betting on and whom we part with.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.e.e4: I have a clear opinion on each one, and it is not always pleasant. Please read it to the end!
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.e.e5: I am proud of our lads' development. Please read the review calmly, I am here for questions.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.e.e6: Whoever makes the right decisions now will have a team from within in two years. I am putting the list in front of you.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.a.a1: Thank you for the honesty. I want to speak personally with the lads who doubt and give them a prospect.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.a.a2: I will go through the list with you and decide together who is promoted, loaned or let go.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.a.a3: I will provide additional funds for the academy so that we can keep the best talents.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.a.a4: Bring the list to the next meeting. There we will decide with the sports department how to proceed.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.a.a5: How sure are you about the potential estimates? Show me where the range is wide and where the picture is clear.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.a.a6: We wait for pre-season. After that we will see who really makes his way, and decide then.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.a.a7: Too much sentimentality. Whoever does not deliver gets no new contract, it is that simple.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.a.a8: The review is too vague for me. In future I expect clear figures and no feelings.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.r.r1: {b.gut} That pleases me. I am glad to keep working with this backing.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.r.r2: {b.gut} That is how cooperation should be. I will prepare the talks with the lads.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.r.r3: {b.gut} With this support we can build the next generation even better.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.r.r4: {b.neutral} Understood, I will work through the list accordingly.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.r.r5: {b.neutral} That is a cautious way. I am curious what pre-season brings.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.r.r6: {b.neutral} I await your decisions and will keep the lads motivated until then.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That was not what I had expected after this season.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.r.r8: {b.schlecht} That is no way to speak to someone who works with the lads day after day!
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.r.r9: {b.schlecht} If that is the appreciation for my work, I will think about whether I stay.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.x.x1: {entscheidung} The youth coach goes to work with fresh energy, and everyone in the academy knows where he stands.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.x.x2: {entscheidung} The review stays on the desk for now. The lads wait, and unrest slowly grows.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.x.x3: {entscheidung} The youth coach falls silent after the talk. In the academy the word of a quarrel goes round.
pool.akademie_saisonbilanz.x.x4: {entscheidung} The youth coach puts the folder on the desk and leaves. The review is not discussed any further.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.e.e1: I am unsure about one of our lads. The potential varies with each observation, and the range is wide.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.e.e2: I want to warn you against a wrong decision. The boy shows class one day and nothing the next, and I cannot place him.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.e.e3: I am sleeping badly because of this boy. I do not know whether I am overrating or underrating him.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.e.e4: Either we give him a clear plan now or we waste his best years! I am telling you openly!
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.e.e5: I have watched him for a long time and want to be honest: it is too early for a verdict. I ask for patience.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.e.e6: If he makes the leap, he is a gain. If not, we have lost time. I want to know how much risk you are willing to take.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.a.a1: Thank you for being so open. Keep giving him your trust, and tell him we believe in him.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.a.a2: We will set three clear checkpoints by which we measure him over the next months. Then we decide.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.a.a3: I will have an additional scout watch a few games so that we have a second opinion.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.a.a4: Let the assistant coach accompany him for a week and bring me a joint report afterwards.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.a.a5: What exactly fluctuates: technique, head or body? Without that I cannot weigh anything.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.a.a6: We leave everything as it is and look again in winter. No decision until then.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.a.a7: Someone who fluctuates like that probably has no future with us. I will plan without him.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.a.a8: I decide by figures, not by gut feeling. As long as the figures fluctuate, he gets nothing.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.r.r1: {b.gut} That gives me security. With this support I can develop the boy purposefully.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.r.r2: {b.gut} That is a clean plan. This way the boy gets a fair chance.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.r.r3: {b.gut} If we follow this through consistently, we will soon know what he is made of.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.r.r4: {b.neutral} Understood. I will keep you posted.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.r.r5: {b.neutral} That only half helps me, but I understand that you do not want to commit.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.r.r6: {b.neutral} So we wait. I will keep giving the boy his training and say nothing binding.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That is hard on the boy. He feels that nobody believes in him.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.r.r8: {b.schlecht} And you think you will get the best out of him with this coldness? I doubt that!
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.r.r9: {b.schlecht} Then he has no future with us, and I will tell him honestly.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.x.x1: {entscheidung} The youth coach leaves the conversation strengthened. The boy feels that people are counting on him.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.x.x2: {entscheidung} The uncertainty remains, but there is now a date on which judgment will be passed anew.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.x.x3: {entscheidung} The youth coach withdraws. The boy notices something is wrong and loses self-confidence.
pool.jugend_potenzial_zweifel.x.x4: {entscheidung} The case is not pursued any further. The boy joins in training without anyone looking after him.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.e.e1: I am calling because a bigger club is interested in the boy. Before we sign anything, I want to know what you offer him.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.e.e2: There is a concrete offer for our player. The family will listen to it if you do not react soon.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.e.e3: The family is torn. We owe the club a lot, but the offer is tempting.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.e.e4: If you do not want to keep him, we will accept the other offer! Decide now!
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.e.e5: We would like to stay, but we need a prospect that can match the offer.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.e.e6: The other club promises appearances and salary. What does yours promise?
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.a.a1: The boy is part of this club, and you know it. We want to keep him, and I will tell you why.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.a.a2: Here he has the path to the first team ahead of him. At a big club he would spend years in the reserves.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.a.a3: I will put an extension in front of him with better pay and a clear prospect. I am prepared to take a lot on for that.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.a.a4: The sporting director leads the negotiations. I will make sure he gets in touch today.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.a.a5: How high is the offer exactly, and what does it say about playing guarantees? Without figures I cannot answer.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.a.a6: I need time to think. Give me until next week, then I will come back with a proposal.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.a.a7: If the family wants to leave, nothing stands in the way. We do not haggle over players who do not want to stay.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.a.a8: He has a contract, and I expect him to abide by it. There is no reason for more.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.r.r1: {b.gut} That is what I hoped. We will talk to the boy, and I am confident.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.r.r2: {b.gut} That sounds honest and like a club that really cares about the boy.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.r.r3: {b.gut} With that prospect the family will not have to think for long.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.r.r4: {b.neutral} Good, I will take that with me and get back to you once I have spoken to the family.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.r.r5: {b.neutral} That is a start but not yet an answer. We have to weigh it up.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.r.r6: {b.neutral} We will wait for your proposal and keep the other club waiting until then.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That is not enough to convince the family. The other offer looks more concrete.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.r.r8: {b.schlecht} That is no way to talk to a talent! Then we will just go!
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.r.r9: {b.schlecht} That is how you will lose him. Other clubs show more appreciation.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.x.x1: {entscheidung} The family turns the other club down. It gets around the youth section that the club fights for its talents.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.x.x2: {entscheidung} The family has not decided yet. The other club waits, and unrest in the academy grows.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.x.x3: {entscheidung} The agent hangs up without a word. A few days later it is said the boy has signed.
pool.jugend_talent_geht_verein.x.x4: {entscheidung} The conversation is over. Nothing more is heard from the family, and the boy's place stays empty.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.e.e1: I am putting in the effort with the lad, but he does not take anything on. For weeks he has learned nothing new from me.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.e.e2: Coach, I have to be honest: the mentor role is not working. He listens, but he implements nothing in matches.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.e.e3: I feel bad because I am not moving him forward. Perhaps I am not the right one for him.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.e.e4: Either the lad pulls his weight or I stop! I will not have my time wasted!
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.e.e5: I want him to get better and am ready to invest more time. But the way it is going, it is a slog.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.e.e6: If he is to learn faster we need a clearer plan. What should he take from me?
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.a.a1: Thank you for thinking about it. The lad needs patience, and I know you have it.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.a.a2: Let us define exactly what he is to learn from you. A concrete goal helps you both more than a vague role model.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.a.a3: I will give you extra sessions after training so you can work on one thing in peace.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.a.a4: Talk to the assistant coach about whether he can accompany you. With a third pair of eyes you will get further.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.a.a5: What is the problem: his attitude, your way of explaining or the position? I want to understand that first.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.a.a6: Give yourselves another month. If it is not better then, we will consider whether another mentor fits.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.a.a7: A mentor has to be earned, and the lad has not made an effort. That is not your fault.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.a.a8: The role stays as it is. I expect you to take it seriously and not give up.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.r.r1: {b.gut} Thanks, that helps. I will give him one more real chance.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.r.r2: {b.gut} That is sensible. It is more fun with you at my side.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.r.r3: {b.gut} That spurs me on. I want him to make it and will do everything for it.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.r.r4: {b.neutral} Fine, I will try again and see how he reacts.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.r.r5: {b.neutral} I am not convinced, but I will carry on. We will see what happens.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.r.r6: {b.neutral} Okay. I will leave it at that for now.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That does not get me anywhere. I feel left alone with the problem.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.r.r8: {b.schlecht} You cannot be serious! I sacrifice my time and get reproaches!
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.r.r9: {b.schlecht} Then look for another mentor. I am out.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.x.x1: {entscheidung} The experienced player takes his protégé aside after training, and the two begin a new plan that same day.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.x.x2: {entscheidung} Mentor and protégé carry on as before for the time being. Nobody is really satisfied, but there is no quarrel.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.x.x3: {entscheidung} The mentor withdraws and hardly speaks to the lad any more. The tension is noticed in the squad.
pool.mentor_schuetzling_stagniert.x.x4: {entscheidung} The mentoring role is over. The lad has to find his feet alone.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.e.e1: In the dressing room the older ones sit on one side and the young ones on the other. Hardly anyone talks to each other any more.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.e.e2: The veterans put the youngsters down, and the youngsters roll their eyes. That will not go well for long.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.e.e3: I notice it is getting me down. We are no longer a team but two camps.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.e.e4: If you do not step in soon, there will be a bang! The old ones treat us like porters!
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.e.e5: I want to keep the peace, but the way it is going cannot continue. I hope you have an idea.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.e.e6: Whoever wants to win needs both groups. We should change this quickly or we will gamble away our goals.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.a.a1: I take you all seriously and will talk to both sides. Everyone should feel heard.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.a.a2: We are a team, and a team needs both. Tomorrow I will explain that very clearly in front of the squad.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.a.a3: We will hold a shared evening where young and old cook together. Not an obligation, but an offer.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.a.a4: I will ask the captain to bring the groups together. That is his job, and I support him.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.a.a5: Who exactly said what? I want to know where it started before I decide anything.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.a.a6: Let us wait a few days. Usually something like this sorts itself out.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.a.a7: There are no camps. Whoever says the word again does not play.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.a.a8: I will not tolerate a split in my dressing room. Whoever does not adapt bears the consequences.
pool.kabine_gruppen_alt_jung.r.r1: {b.gut} Thanks, that does good. If we talk to each other, it will get better.

pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.e.e1: Coach, I have to talk to you. I had an argument with a team-mate before training, and it is not over.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.e.e2: Since the last match we hardly talk. He questions my decisions as captain.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.e.e3: I do not know whether I am still acceptable as captain. The team watches us ignore each other.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.e.e4: That guy undermined my authority in front of everyone! If you do nothing, I will sort it out myself!
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.e.e5: I do not want this to linger between us. Perhaps a clearing talk helps if you are there.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.e.e6: As captain I carry responsibility, also for peace. I need your help to resolve this.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.a.a1: Thank you for coming to me. I will hear both sides and give you the chance to talk it out.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.a.a2: A captain also has to take criticism. That is part of it, but I will mediate so that it does not escalate.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.a.a3: I will seat you both for a shared lunch. Sometimes knots untie better over a meal than in the office.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.a.a4: Please raise it in the players' council first. If it cannot be settled there, I will join.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.a.a5: What exactly did he say, and who was there? I want the facts before I step in.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.a.a6: Give yourselves two days of distance. After that we talk calmly once emotions have faded.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.a.a7: Your opponent is right on the matter. You have to learn to deal with it.
pool.kabine_kapitaen_zerwuerfnis.a.a8: You settle this between yourselves, by tomorrow. If not, I will consider who wears the armband.
